quote: We report the Spearman's rank-order correlation between the two distributions in comparison, averaged across all subjects. The Spearman correlation is used instead of the Pearson correlation since for our purpose the rank of the object distributions is more important than the exact values, which may change due to data variability. The top-1 accuracy (Acc@1) is the percentage of the objects with the highest probability in the source distributions matching those in the target distributions.
